errors.name: UnauthorizedSettlementCaller
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a caller is not authorized to settle primary revenue.

errors.name: InvalidSettlementCaller
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a settlement caller is invalid.

errors.name: InvalidPrimarySale
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when the sale context is invalid.

errors.name: IncorrectNativeValue
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when the native value does not equal the sale amount.

errors.name: SettlementAlreadyConsumed
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a settlement ID has already been consumed.

errors.name: PrimaryAssignmentMissing
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when no resolver assignment exists for the sale context.

errors.name: PrimaryPolicyHashMismatch
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when strict expected policy hash matching fails.

errors.name: InvalidPolicyMode
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a policy mode is unsupported.

errors.name: UnverifiedSplitWallet
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a split wallet cannot be verified.

errors.name: NativeTransferFailed
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a native transfer fails.

errors.name: AssetPolicyReadFailed
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when the asset policy registry cannot be read.

errors.name: AssetNotActive
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when an ERC-20 asset is not active.

errors.name: UnsupportedAsset
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when an ERC-20 asset is not supported.

errors.name: ERC20BalanceReadFailed
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when an ERC-20 balance cannot be read.

errors.name: ERC20TransferFailed
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when an ERC-20 transfer or transferFrom fails.

errors.name: ERC20TransferInvariantBroken
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when ERC-20 transfer deltas are not exact.

events.name: SettlementCallerUpdated

events.name: PrimaryRevenueSettled
events.natspec: @notice Emitted after official primary revenue reaches a verified split wallet.

events.natspec: @notice Emitted with raw sale fields for settlement reconstruction.

events.name: PrimaryRevenueSettlementPolicy
events.natspec: @notice Emitted with policy hashes used for settlement reconstruction.

functions.natspec: @notice Enables or disables a settlement caller.

functions.natspec: @notice Computes the resolved primary policy hash for explicit settlement inputs.

functions.natspec: @notice Returns total official primary revenue settled by asset.
